annotations.title: Recursive Calldata, EIP-712, Solana Wire & Revert Decoder (Free)

description: Decode EVM calldata (recursively unwrapping Multicall3, Uniswap Universal Router, Safe execTransaction), EIP-712 typed-data signatures (Permit, Permit2, Seaport), Solana wire txs, custom Solidity revert bytes, or mined tx hashes (100 free calls/day/IP).

input.description: 0x-prefixed hex calldata/revert bytes, 66-char tx hash, or Base64/Base58 Solana tx

typedData.description: Optional EIP-712 typedData JSON (Permit, Permit2, Seaport, SafeTx)

name: nullclear_decode_calldata
